source.title: Myth 2/6 Piece of Loot Now Available from Labyrinths
source.author: Squishei

notes: NEW verifiable acquisition-route identity for EXACT Midnight leather wrist item 272246 (Miststalker's Wristbands): contemporary Wowhead live Labyrinth article links its leather Wrist entry directly to item=272246 and says Wah'du offers it among Myth 2/6 choices for 3 Mythical Soul Fragments, earned via weekly Tier 8+ Labyrinth chamber quests. ATT's independently compiled Season 2 Delves data likewise categorizes item 272246 under DELVE_COMPLETION/LEATHER, with 12.1.0-12.2.0 season timeline; GearPath codex labels 272246 a Delves Season 2 wrist source. This supplies a concrete plausible origin for scalable versions beyond base preview ilvl206 and explains why the Blizzard Adventure Guide boss journal did not list a drop. Prior independent Blizzard armory ilvl305 EQUIPPED example is not proven to be this Myth 2/6 vendor variant; no exact bonus IDs or itemLink at disenchant time were recovered. Live WoWDB and PTR base catalog mark item 272246 Cannot be disenchanted. These facts DO NOT confirm that any live ilvl305 or Myth 2/6 instance is disenchantable, nor validate Wowhead's existing 140-operation cumulative Looter report. No material output ID, successful complete cast, output quantity, zero, histogram, skill, spec, or release-build at-cast trace found. Separate source corroboration: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ATTWoWAddon/AllTheThings/52152671176355d06a90a71cb49b8cf8df489461/.contrib/.db/standard/02%20-%20Delves/12%20-%20Midnight/0%20-%20Season%202.lua ; https://gearpath.gg/codex/loot.html ; https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/delves/labyrinth-of-kindojan-megadelve-nemesis-rewards ; https://www.wowdb.com/items/272246-miststalkers-wristbands. Original 237362 Umbral Tin (including 242608/242712 unlock), 237359 Copper, 237365 Silver and 236761 Tranquility Bloom source cohorts remain unchanged and not reimported.
lookingFor: 272246 Miststalker's Wristbands provenance for ilvl305 (base-preview ilvl206 versus scalable Delve/Myth 2/6 gear), successful at-cast disenchant itemLink, and independent exact rank-specific Midnight ore/herb original operation cohorts
